# Base Form

---

# **HIN'OBI \- BASE FORM**

---

**archetype:** duelist

**stats:** str 2 | dex 3 | con 2 | int 3 | wis 2 | cha 3  
**resources:** hp 55 | mp 110 | ac 14 | prof \+3  
**weapon:** saber

**form swap cost:** free

**identity:** mobile crowd controller who pressures groups through multi-target attacks and individual debuffs. weaker in pure 1v1 but has tools to maintain pressure

---

## **passive**

### **one-man army**

when fighting multiple enemies (gm determines), gain \+2 ac

### **war of attrition**

granted \+50 temp mp on combat start for 2 rounds

---

## **moves**

### **cloud formation \- utility (2 stars, 10 mp)**

summon storm afterimages across the battlefield. gain advantage on attacks as you strike from multiple angles  
*duration: 2 rounds*

#### ***visual ref**:*

| *![][image1]* |
| :---: |

### **static shield \- utility (2 stars, 10 mp)**

reaction when targeted. gain \+3 ac vs that attack. if they still hit, they take 6 lightning damage. you can still use light attacks this turn

#### ***visual ref**:*

| *![][image2]* |
| :---: |

### **tempest fang \- light (1 star)**

*stat: dex | damage: 4 bludgeoning | 2 hits*  
double backfist \- cockthen face. each successful hit gives attackers disadvantage vs you until your next turn (stacks)

#### ***visual ref**:*

| ![][image3]![][image4] |
| :---: |

### **storm drummer \- medium (2 stars, 10 mp)**

*stat: dex | damage: 3+cha lightning | 4 hits*  
electrified wing chun flurry. on 2+ clean hits, target is stunned until start of your next turn

#### ***visual ref**:*

| *![][image5]* |
| :---: |

### **thunderlash \- medium (2 stars, 12 mp)**

*stat: int | damage: 8+cha lightning*  
blitzes past up to three nearby enemies with saber. hit targets are marked \- they take \+3 damage from attacks for 2 rounds  
*cooldown: 3 rounds*

#### ***visual ref**:*

| *![][image6]* |
| :---: |

### **licér \- medium (2 stars, 12 mp)**

*stat: int | damage: 12+cha lightning*  
concentrated lightning bolt strikes single target

#### ***visual ref**:*

| *![][image7]![][image8]* |
| :---: |

### **licér, wi rós \- heavy (4 stars, 18 mp)**

*stat: int | damage: 5+cha per round on failed save*  
raging typhoon engulfs area. all targets make dex save each round or take damage. while active, targets have disadvantage on attacks due to difficult terrain  
*duration: 3 rounds |  cooldown: 3 rounds*

#### ***visual ref**:*

| *![][image9]* |
| :---: |

# Speed Breaker

---

# **HIN'OBI \- SPEED BREAKER**

---

**archetype:** duelist (phantom variant)

**stats:** str 1 | dex 5 | con 2 | int 3 | wis 2 | cha 3  
**resources:** hp 55 | mp 110 | ac 15 | prof \+3  
**weapon:** dual shortswords

**form swap cost:** 1 star, 5 mp

**identity:** phantom mixup artist who chips you down through unpredictable angles and punishes commitment. dies if caught but impossible to pin down

---

## **passive**

### **hyperactive reflexes**

when an enemy uses special movement (teleport, flight activation, rusher dashes, etc), you can make an opportunity attack. when you successfully dodge an attack, gain 1 star

---

## **moves**

### **twin cyclones \- utility (2 stars, 10 mp)**

gap closer that creates an afterimage doppelgänger. target makes dc 10 dex save. on fail, your next attack has advantage and deals \+4 damage

### **wall cloud \- utility (2 stars, 10 mp)**

swords blur into a defensive wall. immune to most small ranged attacks  
*duration: 2 rounds*

#### ***visual ref**:*

| *![][image10]* |
| :---: |

### **calm before \- utility (2 stars, 10 mp)**

reaction when targeted. auto-dodge attack, leave afterimage that deals 4 damage to attacker

#### ***visual ref**:*

| ![][image11] |
| :---- |

### **approaching storm \- light (1 star, 3 mp)**

*stat: dex | damage: 5*  
momentum-fueled strike. if this is your first attack this turn, gain advantage on the roll

#### ***visual ref**:*

| *![][image12]* |
| :---: |

### **gentle breeze \- light (1 star, 4 mp)**

*stat: dex | damage: 4 (auto-hit)*  
impossibly quick flurry that bypasses defenses. can be used as reaction when enemy disengages  
*cooldown: 1 round*

#### ***visual ref**:*

| *![][image13]* |
| :---- |

### **eye of the storm \- medium (2 stars, 12 mp)**

*stat: dex | damage: 6+dex*  
bypasses shields and frontal defense. unreactable.

### **gust front \- medium (2 stars, 12 mp)**

*stat: dex | damage: 6*  
on hit, your next attack this turn deals \+6 damage and ignores one defensive ability

### **perfect storm \- heavy (4 stars, 25 mp)**

stat: dex | damage: 5 | 4 hits  
make 4 light attacks in rapid succession (roll separately). each successful hit after the first deals \+2 damage  
*cooldown: 4 rounds*

#### ***visual ref**:*

| *![][image14]* |
| :---: |

# Power Breaker

---

# **HIN'OBI \- POWER BREAKER**

---

**archetype:** duelist (tank/striker variant)

**stats:** str 4 | dex 1 | con 5 | int 1 | wis 1 | cha 4  
**resources:** hp 55 | mp 110 | ac 12 | prof \+3  
**weapon:** greatsword

**form swap cost:** 1 star, 5 mp

**identity:** plant yourself and throw devastating attacks. trade hits favorably because you can tank through damage and yours hits way harder

---

## **passive**

### **immovable object**

* immune to forced movement, resistant to physical damage  
* vulnerable to magical damage

---

## **moves**

### **veprux's roar \- utility (2 stars, 10 mp)**

charge yourself with crackling energy. your next attack deals \+8 damage and ignores damage reduction  
*duration: until used or end of next round*

### **veprux's hide \- utility (2 stars, 15 mp)**

reduce all incoming damage by 5\. attackers take 6 damage on contact  
*duration: 3 rounds*

### **gryphix's flight \- medium (2 stars, 12 mp)**

*stat: str | damage: 10*  
unstoppable rush. cannot be stopped by barriers or forced movement

### **veprux's fang \- medium (2 stars, 14 mp)**

*stat: str | damage: 12+str*  
devastating punch. on hit, target makes con save or stunned until your next turn

### **veprux's quake \- heavy (4 stars, 20 mp)**

*stat: str | damage: 16+str*  
ground slam. all targets make str save or knocked prone  
*cooldown: 2 rounds*

### **gryphix's spite \- medium (2 stars, 10 mp)**

reaction when hit. immediately strike back for 8+str damage. if you took 10+ damage from the triggering attack, deal double damage  
*cooldown: 1 round*

# God Breaker

---

# **HIN'OBI \- GOD BREAKER**

---

**archetype:** duelist (berserker variant)

**stats:** str 4 | dex 5 | con 2 | int 3 | wis 1 | cha 3  
**resources:** hp 55 | mp 100 | ac 16 | prof \+4  
**weapon:** plasma halberd (long reach, ignores barriers)

**form swap cost:** 1 star, 10 mp, 5 prior swaps

**transformation:** restore to full hp and mp on activation  
**duration:** until mp depletes (loses 5 per round)  
**lockout:** cannot transform for 5 rounds after reverting

**identity:** adaptive berserker who learns from every hit taken and grows stronger as battle continues. combines all previous forms' techniques with plasma-wreathed precision

---

## **passives**

### **apex evolution**

 whenever you miss an attack, fail a save, or take 5+ damage in one hit:

* gain \+1 to the relevant stat for rest of combat  
* gain 1 evolution stack (max 5\)

### **limit break**

\+2 to all stats when reduced to 50% hp, \+4 to all stats when reduced to 25% hp

---

## **moves**

### **descend \- light (1 star, 6 mp)**

*stat: dex | damage: 5+dex*  
drop from above with devastating speed, plasma trail marking your path. on hit, knock target prone

#### ***upgrade*** \- *(1 stack):*

| *flash-step above target while afterimage descends. strike from an unexpected angle while they track the fake. advantage to hit, create shockwave on landing (3 force damage to others)* |
| :---: |

### **orbit \- light (1 star, 8 mp)**

*stat: int | damage: 6+int*  
wind magic animates halberd to attack autonomously. halberd makes one attack (6+int damage) at start of each of your turns

#### ***visual ref:***

| *![][image15]* |
| :---: |

### 

#### ***upgrade*** \- *(1 stack):*

| *halberd attacks twice per turn insteadduration: 2 rounds* |
| :---: |

### **scatter \- medium (2 stars, 14 mp)**

*stat: dex | damage: 4+dex, 4 hits*  
spin halberd in impossible arc, afterimages assault from multiple directions simultaneously. each hit applies \-1 ac (stacks)

#### ***upgrade*** \- *(2 stacks):*

| *hits create plasma marks. your next lightning attack chains between all marked targets (+4 damage)* |
| :---: |

### **eclipse \- utility (2 stars, 15 mp)**

concentrated aura of plasma and lightning creates oppressive battlefield presence. enemies have disadvantage on attacks against you, you have advantage on saves

#### ***upgrade*** \- *(2 stacks):*

| *also applies \-2 ac to all enemiesduration: 2 rounds* |
| :---: |

### **pierce \- heavy (3 stars, 22 mp)**

*stat: int | damage: 18+int (ignores all reductions/resistances)*  
extend halberd with plasma construct that phases through defenses. cannot be blocked or reduced

#### ***upgrade*** \- *(3 stacks):*

| *on hit, dispel one magical effect on targetcooldown: 3 rounds* |
| :---: |

### **severance \- heavy (4 stars, 24 mp)**

*stat: str | damage: 20+str force*  
single devastating slash sends pressurized wind blade across battlefield. ignores cover and barriers

#### ***upgrade*** \- *(3 stacks):*

| *blade continues past first target, hitting all enemies in linecooldown: 3 rounds* |
| :---: |

### **sunder \- heavy (4 stars, 25 mp)**

*stat: varies | damage: 20+stat*  
reaction when hit. counterattack that changes depending on last damage type taken

#### ***upgrade*** \- *(3 stacks):*

| *target gains vulnerability to chosen damage type for the rest of combat* |
| :---: |

### **erupt \- defense (2 stars, 12 mp)**

reaction when hit. nullify damage, memorize attack type. your next attack of that type deals \+10 damage

#### ***upgrade*** \- *(3 stacks):*

| *also gain resistance to memorized damage type for remainder of combat* |
| :---: |
